title: Africa coverage evidence tranche 1G - Mauritius, Zimbabwe

safety.message: This pack onboards current official sources and creates pending proposals only. Independent review, fresh monitoring, and human-published verified rules remain required.

references.evidence_summary: The Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius operates passport.govmu.org as the official portal for passport and immigration services in Mauritius.
The Zimbabwe Immigration Department operates the official Zimbabwe eVisa portal at evisa.gov.zw for online visa applications.

batch.name: v10.22.11 Africa evidence tranche 1G - MU, ZW
batch.notes: Official-source evidence for Mauritius (MU) and Zimbabwe (ZW). Mauritius's official source is the Passport and Immigration Office portal at passport.govmu.org/passport. Zimbabwe's official source is the Zimbabwe eVisa portal at evisa.gov.zw. Both endpoints were locally probed from the API container and returned HTTPS 200 responses with usable immigration/passport content. Gabon (GA), Gambia (GM), Guinea-Bissau (GW), Democratic Republic of the Congo (CD), and Zambia (ZM) remain blocked or deferred from earlier tranches. Every proposal requires independent human review.
